coordinateSystem: Native source pixels, origin upper-left. Upper curves follow top dark upper-lash ridge; lower curves include the outer lower-lash boundary, not merely iris color.
interpolation: Use a shape-preserving cubic or clamped linear interpolation. Do not fit one symmetric sine curve to all three plates. Clamp at x-domain ends.

eyes.name: red
notes: UpperHalf and UpperClosed ridge positions are dark-pixel measurements except closed x1350, where the lash has ended and the endpoint is extrapolated.
UpperOpen x1230,1250,1290 are inferred from adjacent visible ridge samples because foreground fringe and black pupil/upper lash merge in the threshold mask.
Lower x1170,1210,1330 and1350 are manually inferred corner/white-sclera boundaries; central x1230..1310 lower lash extents are measured.
The old red center1288 is too far right for this v4 canvas; use these source anchors rather than translating the old shader.

eyes.name: gold
notes: Open upper ridge from x1570 through1671 is substantially occluded by foreground bangs: these values are a smooth anatomical extrapolation, not independently observed dark/skin boundaries.
Half upper x1610 is extrapolated from neighboring lash positions because hair merges with the lash; x1650=414 is the actual separate dark-run start below a short skin gap.
Closed x1550=450 is a manually interpolated endpoint; other closed anchors use measured top dark-lash runs.
Lower x1530,1550,1650,1671 are manually estimated corner/sclera contours. Central lower x1570..1630 follows measured outer lash extents.
Right border x1671 is a cropped observation, not the anatomical eye corner. Do not force the upper and lower curves to meet at that border.

protection.keepUnchanged: All pixels outside the two eye masks remain from the approved open plate. Hair displacement must remain pinned over both eye regions and the nose/cheeks.
protection.preserveForegroundFringe: Foreground bang pixels crossing the upper eyes must stay on top in approved-open coordinates. Gold x1570..1671 is strongly occluded; red x1220..1300 contains narrow occluding bang strips. The extrapolated hidden lid curve is not permission to paint eyelid skin over hair.
protection.localAlignment: Align each plate's upper/lower surfaces using its own curves before blending. Include complete original lower-lash extents through y500 plus feather to y514, preventing the stationary old lower lash from surviving closure.
protection.featureConsistency: These upper anchors use the TOP lash ridge. Do not mix with old eye aperture-line formulas, which lie several pixels below that ridge.
protection.crop: Requested camera ROI is fully inside the native canvas, reaches the right canvas boundary, and must not change source geometry.

accuracy: Bounded manual and dark-pixel calibration for closeup study, not subpixel segmentation. Visible central half/closed ridge anchors are usually within 1-3px; annotated occluded/corner extrapolations can differ more.
